dependencies.authority: startup-frozen tenant reference and exact topology fingerprint
dependencies.required_adapter: server-owned TenantIdentityV1 plus PostgreSQL topology registry
dependencies.requirement: One tenant is frozen per release; every live replica registers the same redacted fingerprint.

dependencies.authority: runs table ownership lease, epoch, cancellation fence, and lifecycle rows
dependencies.required_adapter: PostgreSQL RunRepository with heartbeat enabled and lease_clock=database_v1
dependencies.requirement: Process-local RunRecord objects are caches only; authoritative lease deadlines, renewals, and expired scans derive from PostgreSQL database time, and every mutation is owner-fenced.

dependencies.authority: LangGraph checkpoints, writes, Store data, channel mode, and snapshot cadence
dependencies.required_adapter: PostgreSQL checkpointer and Store with one fingerprinted mode/cadence
dependencies.requirement: No memory, SQLite, or per-node checkpoint authority is permitted.

dependencies.authority: none; cached materialized checkpoint history is derived from PostgreSQL
dependencies.required_adapter: tenant-prefixed Redis cache or disabled cache
dependencies.requirement: An empty or stale cache must reconstruct from the checkpoint authority and must never change lifecycle state.

dependencies.authority: ordered run events, receipts, attempt reservations, and terminal delivery evidence
dependencies.requirement: Memory and JSONL event stores are forbidden; durable sequence and idempotency constraints are authoritative.

dependencies.authority: bounded SSE transport replay only; durable events remain authoritative
dependencies.requirement: Either replica can publish or reconnect; Redis loss is retryable and never invents durable history.

dependencies.authority: tenant-scoped inbound receipt identity and leased dispatch
dependencies.requirement: The process-local dedupe adapter is forbidden even though channel ingress is disabled.

dependencies.authority: schedule definitions and immutable schedule versions
dependencies.requirement: Both replicas observe one shared definition authority.

dependencies.authority: deterministic occurrence identity, launch lease, and global concurrency budget
dependencies.requirement: Both schedulers participate; unique occurrence admission and advisory-locked capacity replace a process leader.

dependencies.authority: task lineage, poll lease, terminal result, cancellation fence, and notification intent
dependencies.requirement: Duplicate submissions reuse one row; stale pollers cannot finish or notify.

dependencies.authority: thread metadata, users, sessions, feedback, personal access tokens, credential audits, and ownership projections
dependencies.requirement: Filesystem and process-memory metadata cannot decide visibility or lifecycle.

dependencies.authority: custom-agent definitions and durable native-subagent batches
dependencies.requirement: Per-node file catalogs are forbidden; definitions and batch claims are shared while local execution slots remain reconstructible.

dependencies.authority: immutable accepted snapshot plus fenced Lease/Pod/materialization evidence
dependencies.requirement: A stale Gateway cannot validate, renew, execute, or destroy a newer accepted-material epoch.

dependencies.authority: tenant-prefixed ownership leases and provisioner/Kubernetes resource identity
dependencies.required_adapter: shared Redis ownership plus AIO Kubernetes provisioner
dependencies.requirement: Warm pools remain process-local caches; ownership, teardown, adoption, and accepted material are fenced remotely.

dependencies.authority: startup-frozen artifact, configuration, contribution, and capability tuple
dependencies.required_adapter: empty canonical set or qualified first-party governance artifact with replica-safety declarations
dependencies.requirement: Unclassified and single-replica-only background contributions fail before service startup.

dependencies.authority: tenant-scoped base and overlay revision rows, immutable compatibility attestations, and deployment-projected active material
dependencies.required_adapter: shared PostgreSQL ToolPlaneRevisionService in immutable mode plus one operator-attributed deployment revision
dependencies.requirement: Gateways expose read-only status, bind one coherent promoted revision to admission, reject live mutations, and fail readiness until shared evidence matches immutable projection.

dependencies.authority: none for run correctness; contextual memory remains explicitly non-durable
dependencies.required_adapter: disabled or tenant-isolated remote backend with reconstructible caches
dependencies.requirement: A cold or stale cache cannot alter accepted identity, ownership, receipts, or lifecycle.

dependencies.authority: owner-fenced durable execution-policy state; other rate and token protections remain local only
dependencies.required_adapter: PostgreSQL policy state CAS plus one startup-frozen execution-policy HMAC keyring; no global claims for the remaining process-local counters
dependencies.requirement: Accepted run budgets and compact state survive ownership transfer through PostgreSQL, both replicas confirm the same private HMAC keyring, and the profile does not reinterpret other process-local counters as tenant-global enforcement.

dependencies.authority: lease-fenced run, stream, sandbox, task, and schedule recovery
dependencies.requirement: Every loop can run on both replicas or is backed by a shared lease; no hidden process leader is authoritative.

dependencies.authority: Alembic head, immutable config digest, and deployment artifact tuple
dependencies.required_adapter: Helm migration Job with PostgreSQL advisory lock; Gateways verify head only
dependencies.requirement: Mixed heads, binaries, or config digests cannot register or become ready.

dependencies.authority: excluded from V1
dependencies.requirement: All long-lived connectors, user connection workers, and webhook channel ingress fail profile validation when enabled.
